info.title: Kron Wallet API
info.description: Custodial Kron Smart Chain wallet API authenticated with API keys. All amounts are decimal strings in KSC or token units. Write operations require Idempotency-Key. Each API key is limited to 30 requests per 60 seconds. 2FA is not used by API keys; manage keys from the wallet UI.

bearerApiKey.description: API key created in the wallet UI: Authorization: Bearer ksc_<public_id>_<secret>. X-API-Key is also accepted.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

IdempotencyKey.description: Required on all write operations. Reusing a key returns the same operation or a conflict.

address.description: Destination wallet address. Defaults to primary address.
Wallet address that needs gas. Defaults to primary address.

from.description: Optional source wallet address. Defaults to primary.

amount.description: Token decimal amount, not raw integer.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key
